title: When Design Rules Break: Benchmark Composition Determines Whether Label Informativeness Predicts GNN Aggregator Choice
abstract: arXiv:2606.10249v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We examine whether graph neural network (GNN) design rules generalize across benchmark families by studying aggregator selection (sum, mean, max) on 24 node-classification datasets spanning citation, heterophilic, LINKX Facebook-100, co-purchase, and co-authorship graphs. Edge homophily is only weakly predictive of the GIN-Sum versus GIN-Mean performance gap. Label informativeness predicts this gap well on legacy benchmarks but degrades substantially when Facebook-100 graphs are included. In these dense friendship networks, near-zero label informativeness coexists with a strong preference for sum aggregation, producing gains of 7-10% and up to 13% under extended training. Stochastic block model ablations, including degree-corrected variants matching Facebook-100 degree scales, fail to reproduce this behavior, indicating that mean degree alone does not explain the effect. translated_title: 当设计规则失效时：基准数据集的构成决定标签信息量能否预测GNN聚合器的选择
translated_abstract: 我们通过在24个节点分类数据集上研究聚合器选择（求和、均值、最大值）问题，检验图神经网络（GNN）的设计规则能否跨基准数据集家族泛化，这些数据集涵盖引文图、异配图、LINKX、Facebook-100、共同购买图和共同作者图。结果表明，边同配性对GIN-Sum与GIN-Mean之间的性能差距仅有较弱的预测能力。标签信息量在传统基准数据集上能很好地预测这一差距，但当引入Facebook-100图后，其预测能力大幅下降。在这些密集的友谊网络中，接近于零的标签信息量与对求和聚合的强烈偏好并存，带来7-10%的性能提升，在延长训练的情况下提升最高可达13%。随机块模型消融实验（包括与Facebook-100度规模相匹配的度校正变体）均无法复现这一行为，表明仅凭平均度并不能解释这一效应。在若干与标签无关的图统计量中，谱（此处摘要不完整，原文截断）
tldr: GNN聚合器选择的设计规则无法跨基准泛化：标签信息量虽在传统基准上能有效预测GIN-Sum与GIN-Mean的性能差距，但在Facebook-100密集友谊网络中失效，近零标签信息量却仍强烈偏好求和聚合（带来7-13%的提升），且平均度等统计量均无法解释该现象。
en_tdlr: Label informativeness reliably predicts the GIN-Sum vs. GIN-Mean performance gap on legacy benchmarks, but this design rule breaks down on dense Facebook-100 friendship networks, where near-zero label informativeness coexists with a strong preference for sum aggregation (7-13% gains) that cannot be explained by mean degree or reproduced by degree-corrected stochastic block models.
